conventions.MASK: head not supervised by this label: contributes zero loss. Never mapped to 'unknown'.
conventions.set_target: nara_target is a list: the true class is one of these (dataset does not resolve them). Loss = -log(sum_k p_k) over the listed classes. If the training code cannot do set-valued targets, treat the row as MASK - do NOT collapse to the first element (that would fabricate e.g. 'walking, not brisk').
conventions.used_for_training: false = documented candidate or excluded; true = approved for v1 training (subject to window rules)

window_assignment.classification_heads: assign a window the mapped target only if ONE non-null source label covers >= 90% of its samples (windows.py PURITY; the remaining <= 10% may be unlabelled or another label); otherwise MASK. Never majority-vote across labels with different targets. (The audit draft's extra '100% for transition-adjacent windows' rule was never implemented and is withdrawn.)
window_assignment.interior_only: transition 'none' negatives only for windows whose span is >= 5 s from every segment boundary, recording edge, gap, or unlabeled interval
window_assignment.centre_inside_interval: HAPT posture 'postural_transition' only when the labeled transition interval contains the window centre
window_assignment.event_interval_inside_window: event positive when the (bounded) event interval lies inside [w0+1 s, w1-1 s]

conventions.unit_contract: native units are recorded per stream; convert every stream to g before Inertia preprocessing (m/s^2 / 9.80665; milli-g / 1000; HMP code -> -1.5 + code/63*3). Upstream Inertia HAR loaders feed native units unconverted (mixed g / m/s^2 / mg); the NHANES pretraining data is in g - Agent B to confirm.
conventions.brisk_walking: only GOTOV walkingFast (instructed fast pace) supervises brisk_walking directly (NC licence); DSADS 4 km/h treadmill and GOTOV walkingSlow supervise non-brisk 'walking'; every other walking label is the set {walking, brisk_walking}.
conventions.posture_while_moving: posture is MASKED for gait/cycling/exercise labels (spec 9.2); Nara's decoder places posture mass in unknown while moving - that is a decoder rule, not a training target.

transition_states_rule: null label -> null; posture recumbent -> lie (Capture-24 '7030 sleeping' -> sleep: diary onset/offset is not an event); posture seated_likely -> sit; posture upright_stationary with locomotion stationary -> stand; locomotion containing walking (and not stationary) -> walk; running -> run; else other. transition_derivation.event_semantics: recommend a multi-label (sigmoid per event + 'none') event head: one window can contain both sit_to_stand_like and walk_start (e.g. sit->walk). movement_intensity.whole_body_vs_wrist: Two targets can be separated defensibly only as: (a) whole_body = MET (label-derived, captures cycling/stairs effort that the wrist barely sees); (b) wrist_motion = an analytic function of the window itself (e.g. ENMO or Nara's existing log-scaled acceleration intensity). (b) needs no labels but is trivially computable from the input, so a learned head adds nothing over the engineered feature the spec keeps anyway. Recommendation: train only movement_intensity := whole_body MET target; keep engineered wrist intensity as-is; report the MET head's residual vs ENMO as the evidence of value.
